'''Daniel Tibbles''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Seattle Grand Slam]] on 22 January 2000 with Tosche Station deck (Obi-Wan's Hut / Careful Planning), according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d196">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-seattle-grand-slam-1-22-00d196/ seattle-grand-slam-1-22-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 23 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-seattle-grand-slam-1-22-00d196/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
